# Convert Audio to WAV

- Route: `/tools/convert-audio-to-wav`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `audio`
- Slug: `convert-audio-to-wav`

## Summary

Turn MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC and any other audio file into WAV without losing anything. (Audio tools)

## Details

WAV is uncompressed PCM audio: every sample is stored as-is, so nothing is lost and every editor, DAW and sampler opens it instantly. Media Manipulator converts any common audio format to WAV in one upload, keeping the sample rate and channel layout unless you change them, and offers trimming, normalisation, EQ and the AI cleanup tools on the same form.
### What it does
- Converts MP3, WAV, M4A/AAC, OGG, Opus, FLAC, ALAC, AC3 and WMA to WAV.
- Keeps every sample: the output decodes to exactly what went in.
- Trim, volume, normalisation, EQ and effects can be applied before the PCM is written.
- AI cleanup is on the same form: remove background noise, clean up a voice, or isolate or remove vocals before saving as WAV.
### How to use it
1. Upload audio: Any common audio file, compressed or not.
2. Adjust if needed: Trim, normalise or apply effects.
3. Convert: FFmpeg encodes WAV on our servers.
4. Download: Save the WAV file.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp3, wav, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, alac, ac3, wma
- Output: wav
- Lossless output; file size depends on duration and sample rate.
### Technical details
- WAV output is encoded with FFmpeg's native pcm_s16le encoder at the source sample rate.
- Converting a lossy MP3 to WAV does not restore detail that the MP3 encoder discarded; it only stops further loss.
- Album art in an MP3 or M4A source is recognised as a still picture, so validation does not mistake the file for a video.
### Use cases
- Switch formats for a device: Make a WAV copy for a player that needs it.
- Prepare for editing: Hand a lossless file to a DAW or video editor.
- One file at a time: Turn a folder of voice memos into WAV one at a time, trimming each as you go.
- Clean up on the way: Strip hiss from a field recording on its way to an uncompressed master.
### FAQ
Q: What is WAV?
A: WAV is uncompressed PCM audio: every sample is stored as-is, so nothing is lost and every editor, DAW and sampler opens it instantly.
Q: Will converting to WAV improve the sound?
A: No. Converting a lossy MP3 to WAV does not restore detail that the MP3 encoder discarded; it only stops further loss.
Q: Can I trim the audio while converting to WAV?
A: Yes. Set the start and end in the trim section and only that span is written to the WAV.
Q: My MP3 has album art. Can it still become a WAV?
A: Yes. The art is recognised as a picture rather than a video track, so the upload is accepted and the audio is decoded to PCM as usual.
